entry: **`route_task_to_model` (`S03.route-task-to-model`).** `OpenHandsAgentSettings(enable_classify_and_switch_llm_tool=True, meta_profile=...)`: structured classes (the classifier answers `2`), a direct prompt template (it answers `{"model": "cheap"}`), an answer out of range, and a missing classifier profile. | **`route_task_to_model` on a router conversation (`S03.route-task-to-model`).** The agent LLM is a base `RouterLLM` with routes `planner` (first, so `auto` sends the first turn there) and `strong` (`openai/gpt-4.1`), and the tool comes from `Tool(name="ClassifyAndSwitchLLMTool", params={...})`; the classifier answers `{"route": "strong"}`, then the model `openai/gpt-4.1`, then a route that does not exist. | **Examples 19, 44, 49 and 59 (`S03.multimodal-router-images`, `S03.switch-profile`, `S03.switch-llm-tool`, `S03.route-task-to-model`), blocked.** Example 19 sends an image to `LLM_MODEL` as the primary and needs a vision model; 44 saves an `openhands/gpt-5.2` profile and needs an OpenHands provider key; 49 and 59 hardcode `openai/gpt-5.5` and `openai/prod/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` behind `https://llm-proxy.app.all-hands.dev` and need a key for that proxy. The run's DeepSeek key reaches none of them.
